desc:
🃏 Steal K-pop idol packs, collect every card, and build the ultimate idol empire!

⭐ Sneak into 12 idol worlds: BLACKPINK, Stray Kids, TWICE, aespa, SEVENTEEN, IVE, LE SSERAFIM, ENHYPEN, NewJeans, BABYMONSTER, TXT and BTS
🏃 Grab a pack and RUN! The fans will chase you back to the safe zone
📦 Unpack cards at your base and put them on stands to earn cash every second
⚡ Train on your treadmill to get faster and reach better worlds
🌈 GOD PACKS spawn at sunrise with a guaranteed Divine or better!
☁️ Weather events give your packs Lava, Rainbow, Bubblegum and more boosts
🎰 LUCKY DRAW: trade cards for Exclusive and SECRET idol cards! A new idol every 10 minutes
👯 FRIEND BOOST: +10% cash, training and unpack speed for every friend in your server!
🏏 Smack thieves, set traps, trade cards, and climb the leaderboards

New idols added every day! 👑
